description: Transcribe a session that has ended: speech-to-text over every participant’s microphone, written as timed cues per speaker and language. Idempotent: a transcript already queued, running or up to date is returned. Billed per minute of speech after silence is removed; the Free plan includes 60 minutes. Poll get_transcript until its status is ready. (Requires scope mcp:write.)

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of creating another.

language.description: "auto" (detect each participant’s language), "multi" (a speaker who switches languages), or a BCP-47 tag such as "en". Defaults to the project setting.

name: request_transcript
title: Request a transcript
